messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"verses":[{"verse":16,"chapter":7,"text":"16 And the eagle cried out in a loud voice, saying: “I say to you, Jeremiah the chosen one of God, go and gather together the people and come here so that they may hear a letter which I have brought to you from Baruch and Abimelech.”"},{"verse":17,"chapter":7,"text":"17 And when Jeremiah heard this, he glorified God; and he went and gathered together the people along with their wives and children, and he came to where the eagle was."},{"verse":18,"chapter":7,"text":"18 And the eagle came down on the corpse, and it revived."},{"verse":19,"chapter":7,"text":"19 Now this took place so that they might believe."},{"verse":20,"chapter":7,"text":"20 And all the people were astounded at what had happened, and said: “This is the God who appeared to our fathers in the wilderness through Moses, and now he has appeared to us through the eagle.”"}],"book_code":"4BAR","chapter":7}
